title: Search
summary: Finds chats and groups by name, and a person by their exact @. iOS shows it as the search tab, Android as a search button in the top bar (ADR 0053, parity difference Search). Message text is not searched in phase 1.

userId.description: Matrix ID from the exact @ lookup.

of.description: A matching chat or group (chat-list type).

chats.description: Joined rooms whose name matches, best first.

person.description: The person whose @ equals the query, when the query looks like an @.

phase.description: idle: empty query. noResults: no chat and no person.

editQuery.effect: Sets query. Applies FuzzyMatchRoomName with the query to a search room list at once; after 300 ms without typing, and when the query passes the handle rule, looks up the exact @.

openPerson.effect: Opens the existing DM (Client.getDmRoom) or the person's profile with a start-chat button (bipe-chat/bipe#567).

notes: People search is exact @ only (GET /v1/handles/{handle}); there is no directory and no partial match, so nobody can list Bipe users. The Matrix user directory (Client.searchUsers) is not used.
idle shows bipe_start_chat_search_by_handle as the hint. noResults shows bipe_app_chats_search_none; when the query is an @ that nobody has, bipe_app_chats_search_no_handle.
Chat filter: All of NonLeft, Joined, NonSpace and FuzzyMatchRoomName with the query. DM names are the other person's name (ADR 0141).
Message text search (encrypted, on the device) is out of scope for phase 1.
Bipe logic: BipeHandle.localProblem, BipeHandleResolver.userID(forHandle:), BipeAPIClient.handle (iOS); BipeHandle, BipeHandleResolver.userId(forHandle), BipeApiClient.handle (Android).
Search placement differs by platform on purpose (parity.json differences, area Search, idiom).
